lane: كنبت تكنبت تَكَنْبَتَ He (a man) became contracted [in disposition; or niggardly, or stingy]. (L, as from IDrd.) But see art. كنبث. (TA.) كنبب كُنْبُبٌ , (or this should be كُنْثُبٌ, TA) A hard, strong, robust, man. (L.) But see كُنْبُثٌ. (TA.) === Also, and كُنَابِتٌ, A man contracted [in disposition]; niggardly, or stingy. (L.) But see art. كنبث. (TA.)

entries.text: أكنبت: غلظت، والمضنون: ضرب من الغوالي الجيدة.
